newMessage.title: Welcome line for first-time chatters
newMessage.description: Placeholders: {name}, {visits} (streams they have chatted in, counting this one), {away} (how long since their last stream), {platform}, {community} (your community name).
newMessage.default: Welcome to {community}, {name}! First time here, so grab a cozy spot and say hi anytime.

newMessageAlternates.title: More first-time welcome lines
newMessageAlternates.description: One line per row; a line is picked at random, never the same one twice in a row. Placeholders: {name}, {visits} (streams they have chatted in, counting this one), {away} (how long since their last stream), {platform}, {community} (your community name).
default: {name} just found {community}! So glad you are here.
A new face! Welcome in, {name}. Make yourself at home.

greetReturning.title: Greet returning chatters too
greetReturning.description: Viewers who chatted in an earlier stream get the welcome-back line.

returningMessage.title: Welcome-back line
returningMessage.description: Placeholders: {name}, {visits} (streams they have chatted in, counting this one), {away} (how long since their last stream), {platform}, {community} (your community name).
returningMessage.default: Welcome back, {name}! That makes {visits} streams together.

returningMessageAlternates.title: More welcome-back lines
returningMessageAlternates.description: One line per row; a line is picked at random, never the same one twice in a row. Placeholders: {name}, {visits} (streams they have chatted in, counting this one), {away} (how long since their last stream), {platform}, {community} (your community name).
default: {name} is back in {community}! Thanks for hanging out again.
Good to see you again, {name}! Visit number {visits}.

regularMessage.title: Line for regulars
regularMessage.description: Placeholders: {name}, {visits} (streams they have chatted in, counting this one), {away} (how long since their last stream), {platform}, {community} (your community name).
regularMessage.default: {name}, a true regular! {visits} streams and counting. Your usual spot is saved.

regularVisits.title: Regular after this many streams
regularVisits.description: Viewers who have chatted in at least this many streams get the regulars line.

awayMessage.title: Line for viewers back after a long break
awayMessage.description: Placeholders: {name}, {visits} (streams they have chatted in, counting this one), {away} (how long since their last stream), {platform}, {community} (your community name).
awayMessage.default: {name}! It has been {away}. {community} missed you, welcome home.

awayDays.title: Long break after this many days

showChatMessage.title: Show their first message in the bubble

skipNames.title: Never greet these names
skipNames.description: Comma-separated, for example your bot accounts. Bots and your own account are always skipped.

resetHours.title: New stream after this many quiet hours
resetHours.description: Everyone can be greeted again when a stream starts, or after chat has been quiet this long.

optOutEnabled.title: Let viewers turn their greeting off
optOutEnabled.description: Viewers type the opt-out command to stop being greeted, and the opt-in command to start again. Their choice is remembered.

optOutReply.title: Reply when a viewer opts out
optOutReply.default: Got it, {name}. No more greetings from me. Type !{optIn} anytime to turn them back on.

optInReply.title: Reply when a viewer opts back in
optInReply.default: Yay, {name}! Your greetings are back on.
